fields.description: User's selected use cases, preferences, and Q&A answers as a summary
Total build budget in USD; -1 means the user has set no budget at all
Maximum to spend on CPU in USD; -1 means no ceiling. The user has said cost is not a constraint

JSON list of compatible CPUs with street prices. Fields: name, brand, cores, threads, base_clock_ghz, boost_clock_ghz, tdp_w, socket, ddr_gen, has_integrated_graphics, pcie_lanes, memory_channels, supports_ecc, street_price_usd. The last three are null on consumer desktop parts. That absence is meaningful, not missing data. When a game performance envelope is available, performance_headroom and meets_performance_profile report whether the measured CPU clears it; prefer a verified fit.
Exact product name of the chosen CPU, matching a name from candidates
1-2 sentences. Lead with the value argument, not the spec argument.
One sentence stating the price point at which a different candidate becomes worth considering. Be specific with a dollar figure.
